+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()

+def receipt(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:

+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()

+def validate_projection(projection: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    parts = all_records(projection, "question_parts")

+    require(len(step_ids) == len(set(step_ids)), "duplicate ProcedureStepInstance")
+    part_id_set = set(part_ids)
+    instance_id_set = set(instance_ids)
+    require(
+        all(item["question_part_id"] in part_id_set for item in instances),
+        "dangling ProcedureInstance",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(item["procedure_instance_id"] in instance_id_set for item in steps),
+        "dangling ProcedureStepInstance",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(
+            not item.get("alternative_to") or item["alternative_to"] in instance_id_set
+            for item in instances
+        ),
+        "dangling alternative branch",
+    )
+    by_instance: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for step in steps:
+        by_instance[step["procedure_instance_id"]].append(step["sequence_index"])
+    require(
+        all(sorted(value) == list(range(1, len(value) + 1)) for value in by_instance.values()),
+        "non-contiguous ProcedureStep branch sequence",
+    )
+
+    role_counts = Counter(item["role"] for item in parts)
+    require(role_counts["score_owning"] == EXPECTED["score_owning"], "score owner drift")
+    require(
+        role_counts["instruction_only"] == EXPECTED["instruction_only"],
+        "instruction owner drift",
+    )
+    statuses = Counter(item["status"] for item in parts)
+    require(
+        statuses

+        f"terminal status drift: {statuses}",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(item["terminal_disposition"] == item["status"] for item in parts),
+        "terminal disposition/status mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(item["question_type"] for item in parts if item["status"] == "approved"),

+    )
+
+    canonical_models: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    canonical_types: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for instance in instances:

+            value = canonical_bytes(question_type)

+    signatures = [

+
+    approved_instances = [item for item in instances if item["status"] == "approved"]
